title: The Consensus Trap: Collaborative Interleaved Generation to Defend against a Corrupted Majority
abstract: arXiv:2604.17139v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Majority voting offers a simple way to combine answers from multiple large language model (LLM) agents. When a majority follows instructions favoring the same incorrect answer, however, agreement reinforces the error. We call this failure the "consensus trap": a minority may identify the error, yet its reasoning cannot change a vote over completed answers. We introduce chunk-interleaved Round-Robin (RR) collaboration, in which agents take turns extending one unfinished reasoning trajectory. A minority of agents with correct reasoning can insert corrections that subsequent speakers read before the answer is complete. RRMaj combines several such trajectories by a final vote. We characterize a majority barrier for outcome-level voting over final answer labels and derive a local sufficient condition for expected progress when the minority's cumulative corrections outweigh opposing corrupted updates. translated_title: 共识陷阱：协作式交错生成以抵御被腐化的多数派
translated_abstract: 多数投票为整合多个大语言模型（LLM）智能体的答案提供了一种简单方式。然而，当多数派遵循指向同一错误答案的指令时，一致意见反而会强化错误。我们将这种失败称为“共识陷阱”：少数派虽能识别出错误，但其推理无法改变对已完成答案的投票结果。我们引入了分块交错的轮替（Round-Robin, RR）协作方式，各智能体轮流扩展同一条尚未完成的推理轨迹。具有正确推理的少数派智能体可以在答案完成之前插入纠正内容，供后续发言者阅读。RRMaj 方法通过最终投票将若干条这样的轨迹组合起来。我们刻画了针对最终答案标签进行结果层面投票的“多数壁垒”，并推导出一个局部充分条件：当少数派的累积纠正量超过对立的腐化更新时，即可预期取得进展。在多个模型家族和可验证的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现并定义了多智能体多数投票中的“共识陷阱”问题，并提出分块交错轮替协作方法，让持正确推理的少数派能在推理完成前插入纠正，从而突破腐化多数派对最终投票的操控。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the "consensus trap" in majority voting among LLM agents and proposes chunk-interleaved Round-Robin collaboration (RRMaj), allowing a correct-reasoning minority to insert corrections before answers are finalized so that voting can overcome a corrupted majority.
